conclusion: Lower critic weight reduces global clipping and changes behavior, but deterministic D improves in only one of three paired seeds.
causal_limit: Changing vf_coef affects critic optimization and coupling through global clipping together. This is not a clipping-only ablation; Adam makes raw gradient ratios different from actual parameter displacement.
next_review: No automatic adoption of .05. Review sampling/argmax concentration and reward-D alignment; avoid unbounded coefficient tuning from three pilot seeds.
